entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
May both the hands of Abu Lahab be destroyed, and he has been destroyed.
His wealth did not benefit him in the least, nor did whatever he earned.
He will soon enter the Fire with layers of flames
And his wife (too), carrying the bundle of wood on her head.
A rope made from date palm fibre (will be) around her neck.
